title: Killing tensors on projective spaces
summary: A Killing tensor field on a Riemannian space corresponds to an integral of the geodesic flow polynomial in momenta. A (contravariant) Killing tensor field is called \emph{decomposable} if it is a polynomial in Killing vector fields. While all Killing tensor fields on the spaces of constant curvature and on the complex projective space are decomposable, there is an explicitly constructed family of indecomposable quadratic Killing tensor fields on the quaternionic projective spaces $\mathbb{H}P^n, \, n \ge 3$.
